run_upload_diff: run upload.py to submit a code review diff from Git, Mercurial, or Subversion to a codereview server
create_code_review_issue: create a new code review issue on codereview.appspot.com with subject, reviewers, and patch description
upload_patch_files: upload separate patch files to a code review issue when the diff exceeds the maximum upload size
upload_base_files: upload base and current file contents for each file in a patch to support side-by-side diffs
guess_version_control_system: guess the version control system (Git, Mercurial, or Subversion) from the current working directory
